description: The x-axis of the left plot in Figure 6 shows the hyperparameter N, which ranges from 0 to 20. The y-axis of the left plot shows the F1 score, which ranges from 70 to 100. The x-axis of the right plot in Figure 6 shows the hyperparameter N, which ranges from 0 to 20. The y-axis of the right plot shows the AUC, which ranges from 75 to 100. The left plot in Figure 6 shows the F1 score of the model as a function of the hyperparameter N. The F1 score increases as the hyperparameter N increases, reaching a peak at N=10, and then decreases as the hyperparameter N continues to increase. The right plot in Figure 6 shows the AUC of the model as a function of the hyperparameter N. The AUC increases as the hyperparameter N increases, reaching a peak at N=10, and then decreases as the hyperparameter N continues to increase.
